# Unreleased

## Swift package builds in agent panes

- Add **Settings → General → Swift package builds → Enable SwiftPM compatibility
  for new agent panes**, off by default. Enable it once, then start or explicitly
  restart the agent panes that need it.
- With the setting enabled, SwiftPM build, test, run and package commands use a
  runtime-local wrapper to avoid unsupported nested macOS sandboxes. Project
  and dependency manifests and plugins use the agent's existing permissions,
  including any permitted network access. Parley's outer boundary and vendor
  tool approvals remain active. Human Shell panes keep normal SwiftPM defaults.
- Preserve the PATH-selected Swift toolchain, including mise. The wrapper is
  generated by the packaged application; no global Swift installation or shell
  configuration changes are required.
- The repository's native runner honours the same explicit opt-in for npm test
  and npm run build. The shared agent protocol advances to v18 and includes the
  helper fallback for vendor shells that rebuild PATH.
- Full Ghostty and native UI checks still need validation from a human Shell
  pane before release; SwiftPM compatibility does not remove their inherited
  process boundary or relax release gates.

Move these entries into the release-specific notes when preparing the next
release. Existing tagged release notes remain unchanged.

## Stable toolbar menus

- Keep Ask, Review, Context, Recipes and Return menu items fixed while the menu
  is open, so live pane and collaboration updates do not reset mouse selection.
- Apply the same behavior to nested choices, compact Actions and Waiting.
  Refresh labels, availability and actions on the next opening.

## Agent awareness across projects

- Add local `parley help` (`--help`, `-h`) and `parley protocol` references that
  work without a live broker. Help lists every supported command, including
  reviewed-context operations and reserved person/hook entry points.
- Give every agent an absolute `PARLEY_COMMAND` fallback, retain one canonical
  protocol, and include progress limits, completion-evidence headings, native
  UI capabilities and instruction-recovery reminders in handoffs.
- Document vendor instruction-loading limits and add a fresh/resumed-session
  smoke check. Agy added-directory uptake remains unverified. Add a repository
  `CLAUDE.md` symlink to the existing engineering guide without changing other
  projects' instruction files.
